ranked.headline: Computational methods are resolving spatial cell types, domains, and gene expression
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one publication extend spatial transcriptomics analysis to super-resolution, domain detection, deconvolution, and gene expression modeling.

ranked.headline: Integrating molecular QTL and GWAS evidence to prioritize disease genes and variants
ranked.summary: Recent xQTL, multi-ancestry GWAS and variant effect studies extend noncoding-variant interpretation toward gene prioritization and clinical classification.

ranked.headline: Biology-aware inference from tumor genomes, cfDNA, and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Noninvasive and single-cell tumor measurements are now paired with inference that encodes haplotype, sequence, and cell-state structure.

ranked.headline: Scalable SNP-based genotype inference for pooled and population genomics data
ranked.summary: Pooled single-cell and biobank-scale designs make runtime, memory, and accuracy central constraints for genotype inference.

ranked.headline: Explicit modeling of sequencing error and read-level evidence in genomic inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints embed sequencing error estimation and nanopore dwelling-time signals directly within calling and calibration workflows.

ranked.headline: Pretrained embeddings localize binding residues and transfer across peptide chirality
ranked.summary: Recent papers and preprints pair pretrained protein language model embeddings with residue-level outputs for binding prediction and peptide design.

ranked.headline: Statistical controls for artifacts, batch effects and isoforms in expression analysis
ranked.summary: Recent expression tools span long-read isoforms, single-cell artifacts, spatial DE testing and meta-analysis, each needing explicit error and batch control.

ranked.headline: Generative models couple cryo-EM and cryo-ET data to biomolecular structure
ranked.summary: Diffusion-based models now generate all-atom MD trajectories and fit cryo-EM and cryo-ET data directly within generation.

ranked.headline: Open tools unify heterogeneous biochemical and omics data into queryable annotated form
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool address integration of compound, gene, and metabolite data using LLM and deep-learning components.

ranked.headline: Computational mapping of noncoding variants to target genes and regulatory elements
ranked.summary: Single-cell CRISPRi, allele-specific splicing and polyadenylation, and Hi-C now link noncoding GWAS variants to regulatory outputs.

ranked.headline: Learned and explicitly modelled components reshape mass-spec proteomics analysis
ranked.summary: Peptide identification and label-free quantitation are shifting toward learned representations and explicit handling of missing or error structure.

ranked.headline: Learned models forecast single-cell gene expression and perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a journal article move single-cell prediction toward forecasting, unseen perturbations, and chromatin-based transcription modeling.

ranked.headline: Gene content and genome organization shape lineage-specific trait evolution across taxa
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level and synteny-aware comparative genomes now link gene content changes to lineage-specific traits in four taxa.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based models and pipelines infer pathogen resistance and infection phenotypes
ranked.summary: Read-level pipelines now infer resistance directly from metagenomic and nanopore data, with one reporting results within 30 minutes.

ranked.headline: Learned representations predict drug combinations, interactions, and molecular properties
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply tensor factorization, GNNs, and multimodal pretraining to drug combination, interaction, and synergy prediction.

ranked.headline: TE activity shapes LINE-1 chimeras, fungal transfer, and maize centromere repeats
ranked.summary: Recent comparative pipelines date TE insertions and resolve repeat architecture across fungal, maize, and LINE-1 contexts.

ranked.headline: Sequence and motif geometry methods probe protein and RNA structure inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published resource extend coevolution, alignment diversity, motif matching, and RNA folding to structural questions.

ranked.headline: Hierarchical biological structure encoded into microbiome analysis and modeling tools
ranked.summary: Taxonomic and phylogenetic priors are now built into microbiome feature sets, Bayesian models, and linked activity and viral profiling workflows.

ranked.headline: Language models learn DNA, RNA and protein sequence representations for prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs sequence language models with structure prediction, enzyme turnover, genomic modeling and codon optimization in February 2026.

ranked.headline: Single-cell atlases resolve immune and hematopoietic states across human cohorts
ranked.summary: Large single-cell profiles now link immune, hematopoietic, and lineage dynamics to ancestry, aging, and disease outcomes.

ranked.headline: Evaluation design, not model class, limits predictive claims in biological ML
ranked.summary: Common metrics and transfer strategies can mislead performance estimates, making validation design central to credible predictive biology models.

ranked.headline: Local cell interactions drive collective invasion and tissue-scale polarity in models
ranked.summary: Recent models of passive-active cell mixtures, morphogen-free polarity and cell-type alignment expose mechanisms governing collective tissue behavior.

ranked.headline: Computational screens and designs prioritizing candidates for experimental testing
ranked.summary: Recent reports pair machine learning, docking, and protein design with experimental synthesis, assay, or de novo design of predicted candidates.

ranked.headline: Knowledge graphs and benchmarks evaluate computational drug and resistance prediction
ranked.summary: Public databases and curated ADME data are increasingly used as external references for testing computational predictors across drug discovery tasks.

ranked.headline: Neural and hybrid models infer population history from LD, ARGs, and mtDNA distances
ranked.summary: Recent effective population size, ancestral recombination graphs, and mtDNA trees are now targeted by neural and hybrid inference models.

ranked.headline: Configuration-driven tools build local relational databases for omics outputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe locally deployable, code-free or config-driven tools for building queryable omics databases.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve LNP-siRNA structure, PNPLA membrane binding, and PET hydrolysis
ranked.summary: Multiscale simulations now resolve pH-dependent LNP-siRNA structure, PNPLA2/3 membrane-binding modes, and rate-limiting PE-H deacylation at atomistic detail.

ranked.headline: Software converts raw time-resolved microscopy into quantified cellular dynamics
ranked.summary: Automated extraction of cell dynamics from live imaging is becoming reusable, open tooling for boundary-based and non-rigid analysis.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer post-mortem interval and circadian time from molecular profiles
ranked.summary: Flexible learned models are moving into routine clinical metabolomics and single-sample settings, where cross-platform validation is becoming the key test.

ranked.headline: Decomposition and restricted computation cut runtime of core sequence inference
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published tool reduce runtime of core sequence analyses through algorithmic restructuring rather than new model classes.

ranked.headline: Computational models resolve senescent and low-complexity cell states from scRNA data
ranked.summary: Public single-cell atlases now enable conserved aging-associated cell states and senescence signatures to be mined across organs and diseases.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised models learn transferable omics and protein representations
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of VAE and foundation-model embeddings for scRNA-seq now test whether simple pipelines match learned representations.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link regulatory dynamics to cell states and signaling phenotypes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply Boolean trap spaces, kinase dynamics, and information-thermodynamic models to link biomarkers and states to dynamics.

ranked.headline: Web tools predict siRNA toxicity and catalog peptide-mediated siRNA delivery data
ranked.summary: Recent releases add web-based resources for siRNA toxicity prediction, peptide delivery curation, and short RNA fragment identification.

ranked.headline: Cancer genome studies classify mutation function, signatures and oncogene amplification
ranked.summary: Single-cell and pan-cancer sequencing at scale now supports mechanistic classification of cancer genome alterations.

ranked.headline: Latent-variable and local-learning models account for visual cortical responses
ranked.summary: Recent studies test latent-variable and biologically constrained learning models against V1 and ventral-pathway data.

ranked.headline: Metabolic and energy budgets shape neural coding and synaptic precision
ranked.summary: Energy-aware objectives in neural models and synapses are being formalized alongside scaling-law analysis of masked transformers on single-cell data.

ranked.headline: PCA-compressed Euclidean alignment drives fast 2D classification of cryo-EM particles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair compressed representations and learned models with experimental constraints for particle classification and complex prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict conformational ensembles, antigenic change and nanobody folding
ranked.summary: Three preprints add inference-time biasing, disentangled multimodal features, and folding priors to sequence and structure prediction.

ranked.headline: ML tools for isomiR-aware target prediction and artificial miRNA design
ranked.summary: Machine learning is now applied to both miRNA target prediction and the design of artificial miRNA and siRNA constructs for gene silencing.
